newsitem.title: FRANCE: Self-confessed French serial killer on trial.
newsitem.headline: Self-confessed French serial killer on trial.

text.p: A self-confessed serial killer, who is in jail for two murders and boasts he committed 20 more, goes on trial on Tuesday for his role in the torture and murder of a young soldier.

Francis Heaulme denies taking part in the killing but admits he tied the hands of 19-year-old conscript Laurent Bureau, whose tortured body was found with his skull smashed in 11 years ago in the town of Perigueux in southwest France.
Heaulme blames a suspected accomplice Didier Gentil for the killing. Gentil, who was serving in the victim's regiment and will also be in the box in the Perigueux assize court, denies any role.

Heaulme, a 38-year-old tramp, was jailed for 20 years five years ago for the beach killing of a nurse in Brittany. He was given a life sentence two years later for savagely stabbing to death a 14-year-old girl in eastern France.

He has told police he killed about 20 other people as he wandered about the country. He is under investigation in connection with six separate murders committed between 1984 and 1989 -- those of three young women in the east, two boys on the Riviera, and a 60-year-old farmer in the south.
The 33-year-old co-accused, Gentil, is serving a life sentence for the 1988 rape and murder of a seven-year-old girl in the Alps.
